abstract: Buying wine is an experience unlike purchasing other foods and beverages. Interaction and service are also key factors in deciding whether or not to purchase an item. Merchants that sell their products in wine cellars must also employ personal consultants (PC) to support and assist customers. To support both PCs and customers, our voice application can also assist customers during their breaks in selecting wines. The customer can interact with the application by speaking or by typing and using the app to select wines. Then, the wine cellar staff will be notified and be able to assist the customer in payments and packaging. After gathering user feedback for our system, we realize that some features require adjustments to better satisfy the user's needs. In the future, given time and resources, we would like to implement these changes.

abstract: Many companies want to gather data from their customers or users but are unable to do so, because they might be a small company. Big companies like Facebook and Google have enormous amounts of data about all their users but face many privacy issues and concerns. Small companies don't want enormous amounts of data but just enough to help with their research. That is the problem we're going to solve. As a solution, we will build a platform for companies to host surveys on a website and gather user's opinions and data. A web scraper will help gather images to display to the user while a search expansion will help analyze the user's responses and scrape better images to display while also increasing the accuracy. For our senior project, our system will scrape images from the internet, take survey answers from users as well as perform search expansion for higher accuracy and performance.

canonical_title: AU Room Reservation: Smart Room Reservation Management for University
abstract: The purpose of the AU Room Reservation System is to manage booking details such as booking details and room details because, in the past, we discovered that the university used paper for faculty admin to book rooms, but it was quite difficult for ordinary students to book rooms for any study or project discussion, but the AU reservation system makes it easy for staff to book rooms on the website. Room and booking information can be easily recorded, checked, created, modified, and deleted by staff. AU Room Reservation is a smart room reservation management tool for universities that runs on three platforms: iOS, Android, and Web. It focuses on booking each student. An Android kiosk application for showing today's schedule in each room with a kiosk is another platform. The final platform is a web application platform for maintaining and checking any reservations, as well as managing each room and each booking..
